bias.en: Bearish · capped at the broken $66 support
bias.zh: 看空 · 受制于已失守的 $66 支撑

read.en: Applied Optoelectronics rose 2.4% on Nov 3 to $63.97, trading between $62.30 and $66.58. It is below the falling 5-day ($71.39), 10-day ($71.87), 30-day ($91.02) and 100-day ($112.12) and the rising 200-day ($114.44). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($79.45), and RSI is 34.
read.zh: Applied Optoelectronics 11月3日上涨 2.4%，收于 $63.97，盘中区间 $62.30–66.58。股价位于下行的 5 日（$71.39）、10 日（$71.87）、30 日（$91.02）和 100 日均线（$112.12）以及上行的 200 日均线（$114.44）下方。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$79.45），RSI 为 34。

read.en: The bounce reached $66.58 but closed back under the $65.6–66.3 broken support, which held as resistance. Resistance is $65.6–66.6, then $71.4–71.9 (5 and 10-day, Nov 2 high) and $79.45 (SAR). Support is $61.9–62.3 (Nov 2 and Nov 3 lows), then $59.3 (Feb 25 high) and $50.8 (Feb 11 high). A close above $66.6 would target $71–72; below $61.9, $59.
read.zh: 反弹盘中触及 $66.58，但收盘回落至已失守的 $65.6–66.3 支撑下方，该位转为阻力并有效。阻力为 $65.6–66.6，其次 $71.4–71.9（5 日和 10 日均线、11月2日高点）和 $79.45（抛物线 SAR）。支撑为 $61.9–62.3（11月2日和11月3日低点），其次 $59.3（2月25日高点）和 $50.8（2月11日高点）。若收盘站上 $66.6，下一目标看 $71–72；若跌破 $61.9，则看 $59。

r.en: Oct 30, Oct 22 and Feb 27 lows ($65.6–66.3); Nov 3 high $66.58
